description: A 3HP selector passing one of four inputs through to a single output

params.text: A four-position switch choosing which input reaches output: a, b, c or d

inputs.text: A voltage here takes over from the select switch: below 2.5V chooses input a, below 5V input b, below 7.5V input c, and 7.5V or more input d
One of the four signals, carried to output while it is the one selected

outputs.text: Carries whichever of the four inputs is selected
